sessions.text:
User: Our dispatch API on Project Kestrel is slow and I want to sort out the caching.
Assistant: Sure. Where is the time going?
User: Mostly the database queries, plus some repeated calls to the maps service. I also wonder if we need an index on pickup_zone.
Assistant: An index on pickup_zone would likely help the lookups. Do you have caching rules for Project Kestrel?
User: On Project Kestrel, whenever the freshness window is under 5 minutes, use no cache and query the database directly.
Assistant: Noted: on Project Kestrel, no cache and a direct database query when the freshness window is under 5 minutes.

User: Quick aside before we start on Project Kestrel: from now on, in every project, write every code comment in Spanish.
Assistant: Understood: every code comment in Spanish, in every project. What are we doing on Project Kestrel today?
User: The reporting endpoints need caching. On Project Kestrel, default to a 90-second TTL cache.
Assistant: Got it: a 90-second TTL cache by default on Project Kestrel.
User: Thanks, that's all for now.
